_doc: Human-input ledger. Seeded at P1, populated at GATE 1 / GATE 2, and CHECKED before the build can enter P6. Every input the build needs from a human — credentials, deploy target, spend ceiling, and the resolved undecidable decisions — is one row here. tools/inputs-check.sh (and the phase-gate hook on STATE.json -> phase 6) refuse to start the build until every required:true row is resolved (or explicitly waived). This is what makes 'gather all human input up front, then run to completion' a mechanical guarantee instead of a hope. Store POINTERS in value_ref (e.g. '.env:STRIPE_KEY', 'BUILD-AUTONOMY.md#decision-1') — never the secret value itself.
